            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Computed
                once at creation before this owner is persisted, then stored and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, derived from the stored fields. Starts at
                0 and adds 2 when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household
                of 3 or more members, and 3 when tenure (fiscal years, starting 1 July, elapsed from
                registrationDate to today) exceeds 1.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints as
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, derived from the city using a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region using a
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created on this owner's
                registration day, signalling an unusually high signup volume; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive), signalling it is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise
                false. The city is compared case-insensitively.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                'registrationDate'. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64 inclusive, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored fields.
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>', where normalizedTelephone
                is the E.164 telephone, the email component is the lower-cased email or empty, and
                householdId is the deterministic identifier for the owner's household (derived from
                the last name and postcode).
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not rejected as a household duplicate, was
                created sharing an existing owner's lastName and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone; otherwise false. A declared household member ('sharesHousehold' true) is
                never flagged. Computed once at creation, then stored and returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: When 'possibleDuplicate' is true, the id of the existing owner whose
                lastName and postcode this owner shares; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: Canonical relative URL of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                using the owner's own id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/7'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is

                are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

              title: Member ID

                postcode, FY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex

                that makes it unique.

              example: 'NSW273F1A9C2B4'

                digits of the fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal
                year starts on 1 July, so a July-December date belongs to the fiscal year ending in

## Summary

I implemented the `riskFlag` field on the owner response for the OfficeFloor `POST /api/owners` (create) and `GET /api/owners/{id}` (read) endpoints. It returns `true` when **any** of the three conditions hold, else `false`.

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added the `riskFlag` boolean to the `OwnerDto` schema (so the generated DTO gets `getRiskFlag`/`setRiskFlag`), documenting the three trigger conditions.

2. **`DisposableDomains.java`** (new) — shared source of truth for the disposable-domain blocklist (moved out of `OwnerEmail`) plus `isAdjacent(email)`, which recognises *disposable-adjacent* domains: a subdomain of a blocked domain (`inbox.mailinator.com`) or one sharing a blocked domain's second-level label under a different TLD (`tempmail.io`). Exact blocked domains are already rejected with 400 upstream, so this softer check is what a persisted owner can actually trip.

3. **`RiskFlag.java`** (new) — computes the flag: `possibleDuplicate` true **OR** disposable-adjacent email **OR** city over its soft capacity (≥ 40 owners, the same threshold at which `CapacityWarning` begins, counted case-insensitively to match `CheckOwnerCityCapacity`).

4. **`OwnerEmail.java`** — refactored to reference `DisposableDomains.BLOCKED` (no behavior change).

5. **`RespondWithOwner.java`** / **`RespondWithOwnerCreated.java`** — set `dto.setRiskFlag(RiskFlag.riskFor(owner, ownerRepository))` at response time, alongside the existing `capacityWarning`/`bulkSignupWarning` enrichment.

The visible test `coreRiskFlagFalseNormally` (a unique, email-less owner in a fresh city → `riskFlag: false`) passes, and the full suite builds green.

A note on the two spots where the spec left room to interpret, in case you want to steer them: I read *"disposable-adjacent"* as subdomain/second-level-label resemblance to the existing blocklist, and *"over its soft capacity"* as the city holding ≥ 40 owners (the established warning threshold, hard limit being 50). Both are documented in the OpenAPI description. Happy to tighten either definition if the intended rule differs.
